forbidden_when: Product title contains promotional, price, ranking, shipping, or time-limited marketing claims.
message_cn: 标题中疑似包含促销、价格、排名或营销承诺类表达。
message_en: The title may contain promotional, pricing, ranking, or marketing promise language.
suggestion_cn: 标题只保留品牌、产品类型、核心属性、规格、颜色、数量等事实信息。
suggestion_en: Keep only factual title information such as brand, product type, core attributes, size, color, and quantity.
source_policy: Amazon Product Title Requirements / Product Detail Page Rules

forbidden_when: Title uses decorative symbols, excessive punctuation, or keyword stuffing terms.
message_cn: 标题中可能存在特殊符号、装饰符号或关键词堆砌。
message_en: The title may contain decorative symbols, excessive punctuation, or keyword stuffing.
suggestion_cn: 删除非必要符号，避免把标题做成广告语或关键词堆砌。
suggestion_en: Remove unnecessary symbols and avoid turning the title into ad copy or keyword stuffing.

forbidden_when: Detail page, description, or A+ content sends buyers to external contact channels or URLs.
message_cn: 详情页/A+中不得引导买家站外联系或访问外部链接。
message_en: Detail page or A+ content must not direct buyers to off-Amazon contact channels or external links.
suggestion_cn: 删除邮箱、电话、网址、社媒账号、站外客服引导。
suggestion_en: Remove email addresses, phone numbers, URLs, social accounts, and off-Amazon service instructions.

allowed_when: Only when the seller has applicable regulatory authorization and substantiation for the exact claim.
forbidden_when: Claim implies treatment, disease prevention, medical effects, or virus killing without verified evidence.
message_cn: 疑似医疗、治疗、疾病预防或病毒杀灭宣称，属于高风险表达。
message_en: This may be a medical, treatment, disease prevention, or virus-killing claim.
suggestion_cn: 改为可验证的产品功能描述；如无FDA/EPA/实验报告等证据，不得使用医疗或杀灭类宣称。
suggestion_en: Rewrite as verifiable product functionality. Do not use medical or kill claims without applicable FDA/EPA/lab evidence.
source_policy: Amazon Product Claims / Restricted Products Policy

allowed_when: Only when the exact claim is objectively substantiated and permitted for the product category.
forbidden_when: Claim is absolute, superiority-based, or impossible to substantiate in normal listing evidence.
message_cn: 疑似绝对化或无法证明的营销宣称。
message_en: This may be an absolute or hard-to-substantiate marketing claim.
suggestion_cn: 改成有边界的事实表达，例如 based on internal test、helps reduce、designed to。
suggestion_en: Use bounded factual wording such as based on internal test, helps reduce, or designed to.
source_policy: Amazon Product Detail Page Rules / Product Claims

category: 认证/测试/奖项缺少证据
allowed_when: Certification, award, or test claim includes a verifiable issuer, year, method, or report basis.
forbidden_when: A+ uses certification, test, award, approval, or recommendation language without evidence details.
message_cn: A+中出现认证、测试、推荐、奖项等表达，通常需要标注机构、年份或证据。
message_en: A+ content includes certification, test, recommendation, or award language that usually requires evidence.
suggestion_cn: 补充认证机构、测试主体、年份、报告依据；没有证据则删除。
suggestion_en: Add issuer, testing body, year, and report basis; remove the claim if evidence is unavailable.
source_policy: Amazon A+ Content Guidelines / Product Claims

forbidden_when: A+ content contains pricing, promotion, purchase direction, or limited-time offer language.
message_cn: A+内容不得包含价格、促销、购买引导或限时优惠信息。
message_en: A+ content must not contain pricing, promotional, purchase, or limited-time offer information.
suggestion_cn: 删除促销信息，仅保留品牌故事、功能、场景、结构和使用说明。
suggestion_en: Remove promotional information and keep brand story, functionality, scenarios, structure, and usage guidance.

forbidden_when: Main image OCR/CV detects text, badges, watermarks, or graphic overlays.
message_cn: 主图疑似包含文字、徽章、水印或额外图形元素。
message_en: The main image appears to contain text, badges, watermarks, or extra graphic elements.
suggestion_cn: 主图仅展示实际销售商品，使用纯白背景，不添加文字、卖点、认证徽章或装饰图形。
suggestion_en: Show only the actual product on a pure white background. Do not add text, claims, badges, or decorative graphics.

forbidden_when: Main image analysis indicates a non-white or lifestyle background.
message_cn: 主图背景可能不符合纯白背景要求。
message_en: The main image background may not meet pure white background expectations.
suggestion_cn: 替换为 RGB 接近 #FFFFFF 的纯白背景。
suggestion_en: Replace with a pure white background close to RGB #FFFFFF.

forbidden_when: Review request offers incentives, asks for positive reviews, or asks buyers to change reviews.
message_cn: 疑似诱导好评、返现评论或要求修改评论，属于高危违规。
message_en: This may incentivize positive reviews, offer cashback, or request review changes.
suggestion_cn: 只能使用中立语言请求真实评价，不得提供利益交换，不得要求好评或修改差评。
suggestion_en: Use neutral language only. Do not offer incentives or request positive reviews or review changes.
source_policy: Amazon Customer Reviews Policy / Seller Code of Conduct

forbidden_when: Operation intent suggests review manipulation, listing abuse, false information, or multiple-account abuse.
message_cn: 疑似违反卖家行为准则，包括操纵评论、重复Listing、虚假信息或滥用平台功能。
message_en: This may violate seller conduct rules, including review manipulation, duplicate listing abuse, false information, or platform abuse.
suggestion_cn: 停止相关操作，并提示卖家检查账号健康与政策违规记录。
suggestion_en: Stop the operation and check account health and policy violation records.
source_policy: Amazon Selling Policies and Seller Code of Conduct

allowed_when: Required attributes and enum/type values satisfy the latest marketplace + product_type JSON Schema.
forbidden_when: SP-API Product Type Definitions validation reports missing required attributes or invalid values.
message_cn: 该类目存在必填属性缺失或属性值不符合亚马逊 Product Type Definitions JSON Schema。
message_en: The product type appears to have missing required attributes or values that do not satisfy Amazon Product Type Definitions JSON Schema.
suggestion_cn: 调用 SP-API Product Type Definitions 获取 marketplace + product_type 的最新 JSON Schema，再做提交前校验。
suggestion_en: Use SP-API Product Type Definitions for the latest marketplace + product_type JSON Schema before submission.
